## What RightClick:AI is

RightClick:AI builds custom internal software for service businesses in Singapore with 5 to 35 staff — the dashboards, automations, and internal apps off-the-shelf SaaS won't build. Built and run by Bolun (Ben) Liu, working solo with a tight specialist network — no subcontractors, no handoffs. Clients work directly with the same person from discovery call to deployment. Every system is scoped in writing before any build starts, ships a working MVP on real data, and is built around your business. The client owns the source code, infrastructure, deployment, SOPs, and knowledge wiki outright on delivery. No SaaS lock-in. No platform dependency. Any developer can pick up and extend the system.

## What I build

Custom internal software, scoped to each business. Common shapes:

- **BI dashboards** — sales and ops data in one live view: revenue, pipeline, capacity, client health.
- **Admin automation** — report generation, deck creation, client onboarding, and the calculations buried across spreadsheets.
- **Custom internal apps** — the tool no SaaS sells: CV scoring, delivery ops, review boards, intake pipelines. Built to the client's process.
- **AI workshops** — getting a team using AI day to day, so the system gets used.

Every build is scoped and quoted per client after the audit — there is no fixed price and no fixed package. What a client pays depends on what is being built and how much of it. The system is built on real data, in phases, and the client owns each phase as it ships. The 30-minute discovery call is free; the workflow audit is paid; and the client sees the full scope and quote before any build. I build until it's live and doing the job. Stop anytime — all code delivered is the client's regardless.

After the first build, the system can keep growing one phase at a time, scoped like the last, or simply be kept running under an opt-in annual maintenance arrangement (hosting, updates, AI model refresh, async support). Both are optional; neither is a contract.

## Stage philosophy

**Stage 1 — Operational Visibility.** Centralise the business's data into a single environment so the founder understands what is happening across the entire business without asking anyone, opening multiple systems, or waiting on a status update. The first build delivers Stage 1.

**Stage 2 — Growth Automation.** Automate operational workflows so operations become faster and less dependent on manual effort. The business scales without proportional headcount growth. Later phases deliver Stage 2 capability by capability.

## Why no grants

RightClick:AI does not work with PSG or EDG grants. Grant routes add 3 to 6 months of approval time before any code is written and freeze scope during the wait — the system delivered is the one specced months earlier with less information. Clients pay out of cashflow because they want the system live fast, not next quarter. If grant cost-recovery is the top priority, RightClick:AI is not the right fit. If speed and clarity are, this is built for them.

## The Data Process Thinking Method

Before any automation, every workflow is mapped: input → output at every stage, expenditure vs ROI, invisible micro-processes surfaced, and the data audit (does the data exist, can it support the decision) completed. Most AI automation failures happen before the first tool is chosen. The bottleneck is clarity of process, not capability of technology. One overlooked logical detail can break an entire system.
